text:
tom_sales: Quick sync — FinCorp wants to run a 3-month pilot. Main blockers from their side: security questionnaire (offline KMS + SOC2), an IP assignment ask in the boilerplate, and they need streaming + function-calls + strict structured JSON outputs. Can we list quick wins?

jess_se: Thanks — do we have the exact schema they want? also is streaming hard requirement or low latency preference?

tom_sales: They emailed a sample schema (nested objects, arrays). Streaming is required for low-latency event scoring. They also want SDK examples and a sample webhook integration for their devs.

kevin_runtime: We can support streaming + function-calls + schema enforcement. Quick pattern is: use schema-guided generation and our streaming Responses API. Minimal Node example to hand to them:
```js
// Node (pseudo) streaming + schema + function call
const stream = client.responses.stream({
  model: 'redwood-infer-2',
  input: 'Classify incoming event and call action if high risk',
  functions: [{ name: 'create_alert', parameters: { type: 'object', properties: { id: { type: 'string' }, severity: { type: 'string' } }, required: ['id'] } }],
  schema: { type: 'object', properties: { content: { type: 'object' } }, required: ['content'] }
});
for await (const chunk of stream) { process.stdout.write(chunk.delta); }
```

jess_se: Perfect — can you also paste a curl/SSE sample for their infra team? which SDK version?

kevin_runtime: Curl SSE simplified:
```bash
curl -N -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" -H "Accept: text/event-stream" -d '{"model":"redwood-infer-2","input":"...","schema":{...}}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/responses/stream
```
Use SDK >= 0.9.1 for structured schema helpers.

lena_prod: On capacity: recommend Dedicated for 99th-pct latency SLAs. For quick start we can host them on Redwood Hosted with reserved burst capacity for the pilot — that affects pricing.

tom_sales: They're asking for 50% pilot discount for 90 days — any standard play?

lena_prod: Standard pilot discount: 30% for 90-day pilots with usage cap. SalesOps can approve up to 40% for strategic accounts; >40% needs RevOps/AM exec signoff. I'll open an approval thread.

olivia_legal: We do not assign product IP. We can sign a mutual NDA and a SOW. For SOC2 we can share our report under NDA. For offline/air-gapped KMS: full air-gapped on-prem is a Private deployment and typically takes 6–8 weeks. For pilots, propose Dedicated in customer VPC with customer-managed KMS (AWS KMS) — not air-gapped but meets most controls.

tom_sales: They specifically put "offline KMS (air-gapped)" in the questionnaire. Will that kill the pilot timeline?

kevin_runtime: On-prem private = multi-week engagement. For pilot momentum: offer Dedicated + BYOK (bring-your-own-key) in VPC and provide compensating controls. If they insist on fully air-gapped, escalate to Solutions Eng for a timeline estimate.

jess_se: I'll package the node + curl examples and the minimal schema mapping to send to their eng. Also I'll start filling the security questionnaire fields we can answer (SOC2 link, encryption at rest, BYOK).

sec-bot: SOC2 report available (redwood-soc2-2025) — access link: https://redwood.internal/reports/soc2-2025 (NDA required).

olivia_legal: Action: I'll draft the SOW language to exclude product IP assignment and propose standard data processing addendum + SOC2 NDA clause.

lena_prod: Action: I'll scope pilot capacity and prepare pricing band (30% baseline, request 40% uplift for approval).

kevin_runtime: Action: I'll create a tiny quick-start repo with the streaming + schema example and a sample function-call mock so their devs can run locally. ETA EOD PT.

tom_sales: Action: jess send examples to FinCorp eng and attach our answers to their questionnaire. Olivia please include the SOW note about IP. Lena confirm pricing back to me. Everyone tag updates in this thread before EOD PST. :thumbsup:

jess_se: On it — sending now.
